;Disasters and accidents
*[[2018 European heat wave]]
**A heat wave in [[Spain]] kills nine people. [https://www.publico.es/sociedad/seis-fallecidos-ola-calor-espana.html (''Público'')]
**A heat wave in [[Genoa]], [[Italy]], kills seven people. [https://www.genova24.it/2018/08/allarme-caldo-sette-morti-sospette-in-48-ore-202931/ (Genova24)]
*Landslides triggered by floods in [[Nepal]] kill nine people. [https://thehimalayantimes.com/news-archives/latest/landslide-claims-nine-lives-in-jajarkot-village/ (''The Himalayan'')]
*A fuel tanker explodes on the [[Autostrada A14 (Italy)|A14 motorway]] after colliding with a lorry near [[Bologna Airport]] in [[Italy]], causing a section of the motorway to collapse. A person dies and 145 others are injured, at least 14 seriously. [http://www.ansa.it/english/news/general_news/2018/08/07/145-injured-in-bologna-blaze-four-badly_5a9a9aff-813e-4ae2-992a-ffee2997f620.html (ANSA)]
*Twelve migrant workers die and three others are injured when a truck collides with a van in [[Foggia]], [[Italy]]. [http://www.ansa.it/english/news/general_news/2018/08/06/12-killed-in-puglia-road-accident_6c4e89a0-ba7d-4561-b13c-577e18302a02.html (ANSA)]
*The [[Mendocino Complex Fire]] grows into the largest active wildfire in California history. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-45093636 (BBC)]

;International relations
*[[Iran–United States relations]], [[Joint Comprehensive Plan of Action]]
**The [[United States]] reimposes sanctions on [[Iran]] after [[United States withdrawal from the Joint Comprehensive Plan of Action|the US pulled out of the international agreement]] three months prior. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-iran-nuclear/u-s-revives-sanctions-to-further-damage-irans-economy-idUSKBN1KR1N3 (Reuters)]
**The [[European Union]] announces that its [[blocking statute]] against the US sanctions will take effect tomorrow, protecting European companies from US sanctions and encouraging them to keep trading with Iran. [https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/2018/08/06/america-dismisses-eu-blocking-statute-iran-sanctions-finally/ (''The Telegraph'')]
*[[Foreign relations of Brazil]], [[Crisis in Venezuela (2012–present)]]
**[[Brazil]] closes [[Brazil–Venezuela border|its international border]] with [[Venezuela]], following a similar move enacted but then rescinded by [[Colombia]] earlier in 2018, as a response to an increase in Venezuelans fleeing their country to neighbouring states. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2018/aug/06/brazil-shuts-border-venezuelan-migrants (''The Guardian'')]
*[[Tajikistan–Uzbekistan relations]]
**Commercial flights have resumed between the [[Tajikistan]] capital, [[Dushanbe]], and the [[Uzbekistan]] city of [[Bukhara]] amid improving ties. [https://www.rferl.org/a/flights-between-dushanbe-bukhara-resume-amid-improving-tajik-uzbek-ties/29415799.html (rferl)]

;Politics and elections
*[[Caracas drone explosions]]
**[[President of Venezuela|Venezuelan President]] [[Nicolás Maduro]] skips a rally in [[Caracas]] following weekend drone blasts that he called an assassination attempt, surprising and confusing some supporters in attendance. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-venezuela-politics/venezuelas-maduro-rallies-supporters-after-drone-blasts-idUSKBN1KR1SM (Reuters)]
**The [[Colombian Civil Aviation Authority]] announces a ban on drones within a 2 nautical mile radius and altitude of Plaza Bolívar, [[Bogotá]] during the Presidential Inauguration of [[Iván Duque]] the following afternoon. [http://www.t13.cl/noticia/mundo/prohiben-drones-acto-posesion-duque-colombia (Tele13)]
*[[Second Ivorian Civil War]]
**The government of [[Ivory Coast]] grants amnesty to former First Lady [[Simone Gbagbo]] a week after the {{ill|Supreme Court of Ivory Coast|fr|Cour suprême (Côte d'Ivoire)}} overturned her acquittal for [[crimes against humanity]]. [https://www.france24.com/en/20180806-ivory-coast-announces-amnesty-former-first-lady-simone-gbagbo (France 24)]

;Science and technology
*[[Facebook]] removes several ''[[InfoWars]]''-related pages from its platform, for what it describes as glorification of violence and dehumanizing language. [[YouTube]] deletes [[Alex Jones]]'s main account for repeated Terms of Service violations. [[Apple Inc.|Apple]] and [[Spotify]] pull Jones's podcasts. Editor [[Paul Joseph Watson]] calls Facebook's move "political censorship" on [[Twitter]]. [https://www.nbcnews.com/news/amp/ncna897861 (NBC News)]
